description.value:
Requirements A Cardplay effect you created that lasts 1 round expired at the start of your turn, or you are maintaining a Cardplay effect that has a sustained duration that you have not Sustained this turn.

You rewind and recount the power of one of your divinations to sustain its benefits. Select one of the Cardplay effects that meet the requirements of this action and roll a 1d6. On a 2-5 on the dice roll, you recreate the expired effect for 1 round or Sustain the sustained effect. On a 6, you regain the action you used for Double-Up. On a 1, you @UUID[Compendium.immortal-ardor.classes.arhOfryj6gDtqwZO]{Effect: Bust!}, and you can no longer attempt to Double-Up or Sustain that effect.

You can choose to Play a card when you Double-Up. If you do, Double-Up becomes a free action and gains the Cardplay trait. On a 6, you reclaim the card you Played.
